news.title: Meet the Press NOW — July 27
news.description: President Trump travels to Michigan ahead of the state’s primary to promote his administration’s economic agenda despite recent polls showing voter concerns about inflation. The U.S. pauses military strikes on Iran as the administration pursues a diplomatic path forward.
